subjPresentPerfect.es: Me alegra que hayan visto a su abuela.
subjPresentPerfect.en: I'm glad they've seen their grandmother.

subjPluperfect.es: Si hubieras visto su cara, te habrías reído.
subjPluperfect.en: If you had seen his face, you would have laughed.

impAffirmative.es: Ve esa película, te va a encantar.
impAffirmative.en: Watch that movie, you're going to love it.

impNegative.es: No vean las noticias antes de dormir.
impNegative.en: Don't watch the news before going to sleep.

present.es: Vuelvo en cinco minutos.
present.en: I'll be back in five minutes.

preterite.es: Mi tío volvió a Cuba después de veinte años.
preterite.en: My uncle returned to Cuba after twenty years.

imperfect.es: Volvíamos a casa caminando por el malecón.
imperfect.en: We used to walk home along the seawall.

future.es: Volveré a llamarte esta noche.
future.en: I'll call you again tonight.

conditional.en: Would you go back to living in your town?

presentPerfect.es: Mis hijos ya han vuelto de la escuela.
presentPerfect.en: My kids have already come back from school.

pluperfect.es: Ella nunca había vuelto a su país.
pluperfect.en: She had never gone back to her country.

futurePerfect.es: Para el lunes ya habremos vuelto de Cartagena.
futurePerfect.en: By Monday we will have come back from Cartagena.

conditionalPerfect.es: Yo habría vuelto antes, pero perdí el vuelo.
conditionalPerfect.en: I would have come back sooner, but I missed my flight.

subjPresent.es: Espero que vuelvas pronto.
subjPresent.en: I hope you come back soon.

subjImperfect.es: Mi abuela quería que volvieran para Navidad.
subjImperfect.en: My grandmother wanted them to come back for Christmas.

subjImperfectSe.es: Temíamos que no volviese nunca.
subjImperfectSe.en: We were afraid he would never come back.

subjPresentPerfect.es: Me alegra que haya vuelto a sonreír.
subjPresentPerfect.en: I'm glad she has started smiling again.

subjPluperfect.es: Si hubiéramos vuelto antes, la habríamos visto.
subjPluperfect.en: If we had come back sooner, we would have seen her.

impAffirmative.en: Come back early, please.
